Read its linked [correction evidence](benchmark/writing/review-corrections.json), which records exact before/after mutations and protected-input claims.
The [task graph](.session/tasks.json) assigns reviewer/default/high, 90 minutes and 55 turns, with reports #481, #485 and #489 exported.
The reviewer must independently close or retain each finding, verify original requirements and check regressions.
Candidate identity is anchored to prepared checkout `d3c697c375ed7dc880e55ab3cc2219577cd133a5` and #489's seven output hashes; checkpoint and published identities must be reconciled.
Historical baseline and original reviewed candidate remain separately pinned; protected hashes and preparation-index pins must be checked.

Read the graph back once and checked its structure, allowed role/model, sections, empty dependencies and limits by inspection; no shell execution was available.
Updated [working memory](journal/working-memory.md) with accepted correction state, deferred threads and review handoff.
No LabVIEW execution, native benchmark readiness, product improvement or owner method acceptance is claimed.

## What next
Run the planned reviewer session, then read its actual report and linked evidence before selecting further work.
If findings remain, correct only evidenced defects; if they close, select the next concrete readiness gap, including the deferred #446 review after reading its evidence. Avoid repeating POC delivery, unchanged design work or global gap maps.
